{"items": [
{"type": "reference", "text": "47 U.S.C. 254(h) and (l)", "cited_instrument": "47 U.S.C. 254(h) and (l)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "FCC Form 471", "cited_instrument": "FCC Form 471"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "FCC Form 479", "cited_instrument": "FCC Form 479"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The billed entity for a library that receives discounts for internet access and internal connections must certify, on FCC Form 471, that an internet safety policy is being enforced.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The billed entity for a library that receives discounts for internet access and internal connections", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "on FCC Form 471"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If the library is an eligible member of a consortium but is not the billed entity for the consortium, the library must instead certify on FCC Form 479 (“Certification to Consortium Leader of Compliance with the Children's internet Protection Act”) that an internet safety policy is being enforced.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the library", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "on FCC Form 479"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The Internet safety policy adopted and enforced pursuant to 47 U.S.C. 254(h) must include a technology protection measure that protects against Internet access by both adults and minors to visual depictions that are obscene, child pornography, or, with respect to use of the computers by minors, harmful to minors.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The Internet safety policy adopted and enforced pursuant to 47 U.S.C. 254(h)", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The library must enforce the operation of the technology protection measure during use of its computers with Internet access, although an administrator, supervisor, or other person authorized by the certifying authority under paragraph (a)(2) of this section may disable the technology protection measure concerned, during use by an adult, to enable access for bona fide research or other lawful purpose.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The library", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "an administrator, supervisor, or other person authorized by the certifying authority under paragraph (a)(2) of this section may disable the technology protection measure concerned, during use by an adult, to enable access for bona fide research or other lawful purpose.", "force": "permission", "binds": "an administrator, supervisor, or other person authorized by the certifying authority", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "authorized by the certifying authority under paragraph (a)(2) of this section"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The Internet safety policy adopted and enforced pursuant to 47 U.S.C. 254(l) must address all of the following issues:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The Internet safety policy adopted and enforced pursuant to 47 U.S.C. 254(l)", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "A library must satisfy its obligations to make certifications by making one of the following certifications required by paragraph (c)(2) of this section on FCC Form 471:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "A library", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "on FCC Form 471"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The billed entity of a consortium, as defined in paragraph (a)(3) of this section, other than one requesting only discounts on telecommunications services for consortium members, must collect from the authority for each of its school and library members, one of the following signed certifications on FCC Form 479 (“Certification to Consortium Leader of Compliance with the Children's Internet Protection Act”), which must be submitted to the billed entity consistent with paragraph (c)(1) or paragraph (c)(2) of this section:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The billed entity of a consortium", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "signed certifications on FCC Form 479"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The billed entity for a consortium, as defined in paragraph (a)(3) of this section, must make one of the following two certifications on FCC Form 471:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The billed entity for a consortium", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "on FCC Form 471"}
]}

{"items": [
{"type":"definition","term":"School","text":"For the purposes of the certification requirements of this rule, school means school, school board, school district, local education agency or other authority responsible for administration of a school."},
{"type":"definition","term":"Library","text":"For the purposes of the certification requirements of this rule, library means library, library board or authority responsible for administration of a library."},
{"type":"definition","term":"Billed entity","text":"In the case of a consortium, the billed entity is the lead member of the consortium."},
{"type":"reference","text":"§ 54.500","cited_instrument":"47 CFR 54.500"},
{"type":"definition","term":"minor","text":"The term “minor” means any individual who has not attained the age of 17 years."},
{"type":"definition","term":"obscene","text":"The term “obscene” has the meaning given such term in 18 U.S.C. 1460."},
{"type":"reference","text":"18 U.S.C. 1460","cited_instrument":"18 U.S.C. 1460"},
{"type":"definition","term":"child pornography","text":"The term “child pornography” has the meaning given such term in 18 U.S.C. 2256."},
{"type":"reference","text":"18 U.S.C. 2256","cited_instrument":"18 U.S.C. 2256"},
{"type":"definition","term":"harmful to minors","text":"The term “harmful to minors” means any picture, image, graphic image file, or other visual depiction that—"},
{"type":"definition","term":"sexual act; sexual contact","text":"The terms “sexual act” and “sexual contact” have the meanings given such terms in 18 U.S.C. 2246."},
{"type":"reference","text":"18 U.S.C. 2246","cited_instrument":"18 U.S.C. 2246"},
{"type":"definition","term":"technology protection measure","text":"The term “technology protection measure” means a specific technology that blocks or filters Internet access to the material covered by a certification under paragraph (c) of this section."},
{"type":"obligation","text":"A school or library that receives discounts for Internet access and internal connections services under the federal universal service support mechanism for schools and libraries, must make such certifications as described in paragraph (c) of this section.","force":"obligation","binds":"A school or library that receives discounts for Internet access and internal connections services","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The certifications required and described in paragraph (c) of this section must be made in each funding year.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"in each funding year"},
{"type":"reference","text":"47 U.S.C. 254(h) and (l)","cited_instrument":"47 U.S.C. 254(h) and (l)"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Schools and libraries that only receive discounts for telecommunications services under the federal universal service support mechanism for schools and libraries are not subject to the requirements 47 U.S.C. 254(h) and (l), but must indicate, pursuant to the certification requirements in paragraph (c) of this section, that they only receive discounts for telecommunications services.","force":"obligation","binds":"Schools and libraries that only receive discounts for telecommunications services","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The billed entity for a school that receives discounts for internet access or internal connections must certify on FCC Form 471 that an internet safety policy is being enforced.","force":"obligation","binds":"The billed entity for a school that receives discounts for internet access or internal connections","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"on FCC Form 471"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"If the school is an eligible member of a consortium but is not the billed entity for the consortium, the school must certify instead on FCC Form 479 (“Certification to Consortium Leader of Compliance with the Children's internet Protection Act”) that an internet safety policy is being enforced.","force":"obligation","binds":"the school","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"on FCC Form 479"},
{"type":"reference","text":"FCC Form 471","cited_instrument":"FCC Form 471"},
{"type":"reference","text":"FCC Form 479","cited_instrument":"FCC Form 479"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The Internet safety policy adopted and enforced pursuant to 47 U.S.C. 254(h) must include a technology protection measure that protects against Internet access by both adults and minors to visual depictions that are obscene, child pornography, or, with respect to use of the computers by minors, harmful to minors.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The school must enforce the operation of the technology protection measure during use of its computers with Internet access, although an administrator, supervisor, or other person authorized by the certifying authority under paragraph (a)(1) of this section may disable the technology protection measure concerned, during use by an adult, to enable access for bona fide research or other lawful purpose.","force":"obligation","binds":"The school","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"an administrator, supervisor, or other person authorized by the certifying authority under paragraph (a)(1) of this section may disable the technology protection measure concerned, during use by an adult, to enable access for bona fide research or other lawful purpose.","force":"permission","binds":"an administrator, supervisor, or other person authorized by the certifying authority","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"authorized by the certifying authority under paragraph (a)(1) of this section"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"This Internet safety policy must also include monitoring the online activities of minors.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Beginning July 1, 2012, schools' Internet safety policies must provide for educating minors about appropriate online behavior, including interacting with other individuals on social networking Web sites and in chat rooms and cyberbullying awareness and response.","force":"obligation","binds":"schools","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"Beginning July 1, 2012"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The Internet safety policy adopted and enforced pursuant to 47 U.S.C. 254(l) must address all of the following issues:","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"A school must satisfy its obligations to make certifications by making one of the following certifications required by paragraph (c)(1) of this section on FCC Form 471:","force":"obligation","binds":"A school","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"on FCC Form 471"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Children's internet Protection Act, as codified at 47 U.S.C. 254(h) and (l)","cited_instrument":"Children's Internet Protection Act, 47 U.S.C. 254(h) and (l)"}
]}
